meta.title: The Little Dragon
meta.textType: story: the main idea of a picture story

paragraphs: On Sunday evening, Lily drew a picture story for the Explorers. Tom sat next to her and gave her ideas. She used colored pencils, and she worked for one hour. Pip slept under the table. "Tell me the story," said Tom. "It has six pictures," said Lily.

In picture one, a small dragon lived on a cold planet. It was dark, and the planet was empty. The dragon had two green wings. He wanted to find a warm home. He did not like the cold, and he did not like to be alone. In picture two, he flew south for a long time. He crossed a big river, and he was tired.

In picture three, the dragon saw a village. The people sat in the dark with cold food. They had no fire. The people were hungry, and the children were cold. In picture four, the dragon made a big fire. The girl and her little brother ran to him and said thank you. "Such a nice fire!" said the girl. In picture five, the people cooked rice and fish on the fire. They gave the dragon a big bowl of soup. In picture six, the dragon slept in a small house and smiled.

"I understand the main idea," said Tom. "The dragon helps the people, and they give him a home." "Yes!" said Lily. "Why did he fly south?" asked Tom. "The south is warm in my story," said Lily. Tom looked at picture four again. He thought about the story for a minute. "I like the fire," he said.

Pip woke up and looked at the pictures. He barked at the dragon in picture four. Lily laughed. On Thursday, she showed the story to the club. All the children looked at the six pictures for a long time. "Such clear pictures!" said Teacher Kim. "I can understand the story without words." Lily smiled, and Tom smiled too.
text.summary: Lily draws a picture story of six pictures for the Explorers. A small dragon leaves his cold planet and flies south, and he finds a home in a village where he helps the people with fire.
